| description = Does not aggro players like other ghosts in the area (cons indifferent).  Shares a room with a few other hostile ghosts.  Is not a rare spawn, always up and has no placeholder.  Will respawn every 21 minutes and 30 seconds.


The small area up the stairs before the last door leading to her is a safe spot. Easiest way to solo her is setup there with a fully buffed animation and pull her with a lull crit fail, other ghosts won't assist. If you slow her, animation can handle her with a little help. Just make sure you're ready to throw mezzes when she will try to chain heal at 40%. You can always use a revenant pet and lull the room but some revenants are immune to charm/mez, so while not impossible it can make things a lot more complicated if you're unlucky with spawn RNG.
